patch.value: Adopt the canonical pm-ops docstring gate and document all source declarations
Wire the fleet's canonical pm-ops/docstrings analyzer into pm-linear as a mandatory release gate and document every source declaration it requires, rather than copying a weaker fork.

The canonical pm-ops/docstrings analyzer is adopted via a thin scripts/docstring-gate.ts launcher that imports analyzeDocstringCoverage; no docstring-gate fork is copied; npm run docstring is added and inserted into release:check and the CI workflow so a release cannot ship undocumented declarations; The violation count is driven from 34 to 0 against the canonical analyzer; A test covers the gate's clean and violation paths plus the main/isMainInvocation entry points

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Before (canonical pm-ops/docstrings analyzer @2026.8.8): files=2, declarations_checked=37, violations=34 (8% documented). Violations spanned index.ts only: EXIT_CODE, CommandError(+exitCode), LinearIssue, readNumberOption, readBooleanOption, readProjectMapOption, TeamSelection, invertStatusMap, resolveLinearStateName, ProjectMap, buildProvenance, parseProvenance, IssueFilterFlags, AuthHttpError(+status), backoffDelayMs, parseRetryAfter, linearRequestOnce, linearRequest, readPmItems, AtomicImportOptions, resolveTeamContext, resolveLabelIds, resolveCycleId, resetCycleWarning, applyPushDynamicFields, ExportMutationPlan, commandMutatesLinear, preflightLinear, maskApiKey, buildValidationReport, assertPreflightOk, renderImportDryRun.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: After: npm run docstring -> docstring-gate: 4 file(s), 42 declaration(s) documented. (0 violations; coverageGate reports scripts/ excluded from the measured source set, so the gate scripts add no coverage burden).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Adoption: copied pm-rl's scripts/docstring-gate.ts (thin launcher importing analyzeDocstringCoverage from pm-ops/docstrings, pure runGate + main that sets process.exitCode) and scripts/script-launcher.ts verbatim. Added pm-ops@^2026.8.8 to devDependencies; added the 'docstring' script and inserted it into release:check and ci.yml (after Build, before the coverage gate). NO fork copied; pm-ops itself unchanged.

patch.value: Adopted the canonical pm-ops/docstrings analyzer (pm-ops@^2026.8.8) via a thin scripts/docstring-gate.ts launcher; documented all 34 previously-undocumented declarations (37->0 violations, 42 declarations now documented across 4 files); wired npm run docstring into release:check and ci.yml; added test/docstring-gate.test.ts. No fork copied; typecheck/build/test/coverage/docstring/audit/pack all green.
